_comment: Tier-2 for dune::linear_elasticity#0 and #5 — one fixture, one vector space, no scheme (wall time 2 s on a warm cache, 2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured: lagrange(gridView, order=1).dimRange == 1, so the scalar space is the default; space.interpolate([0,0]) on it raises AttributeError; sym(grad(u)) on it raises ValueError 'Symmetric part of tensor with rank != 2 is undefined.' — the UFL-level death the claim describes. With dimRange=2 the same elasticity form builds and carries 2 arguments. Layout: np.array(uh.as_numpy) for the interpolant of (x, 2y) on a 16x16 Q1 vector space is ONE flat array of 578 entries = 17*17 nodes x 2; reshape(-1,2) recovers u_x in [0,1] and u_y in [0,2] exactly, and all 136 entries above 1.0 (which can only be u_y dofs) sit at ODD flat indices. Both facts are needed: under a blocked [all u_x | all u_y] layout reshape(-1,2) would mix the components and both columns would reach 2.0. The half/half misreading differs from the correct one by 1.0 at the worst entry while looking perfectly plausible in range — that is the silent-wrong. Note the 'entries above one are all in the second half' line is printed for completeness and is NOT evidence: u_y = 2y exceeds 1 exactly on the upper half of the domain, which is the second half of this node ordering anyway. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 re-orders the flat dof array into the BLOCKED layout [all u_x | all u_y] before the layout tests run. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'interleaved_reshape_is_correct=True', 'entries_above_one_are_all_at_odd_indices=True', 'dune_vector_space_layout_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
expect_in_output: Symmetric part of tensor with rank != 2 is undefined.
